scope: Exact ratchet, not zero-cycle or whole-platform dead-code certification. Public Core/binary/embedding entry points and computed worker/browser/test entries are excluded in the checker. Existing internal named exports below are retained, not inferred removable from static non-use; the audit authorizes only its reviewed removal list. Every new value cycle/edge, eager replacement of a deferred edge, unused value export or stale exception fails.

cycles.reason: Finite question grammar and specialized-operation normalization call each other only during operations; retain the shared concrete policy, not a new dispatcher. Neither edge performs eager cross-module invocation.

Credential service composes native issuer refresh/device functions, which borrow its redactor; device polling selects the actual issuer. Uses are function-scoped, not eager class construction. Preserve exact refresh/redactor/native-owner identities; do not generalize authority or split issuer lifetimes merely to remove a graph component.

Concrete codemode/search activation registration is mutually recursive at operation time. Admission/error/provider execution no longer belongs to this SCC. Preserve the one registry and activation ownership; no eager invocation across these declarations.

Intentional deferred imports of the actual public Core namespace preserve extension class/private-owner identity. Replacing either deferred edge with an eager import is forbidden, even with identical module membership.

Workspace refresh deliberately borrows the canonical Zustand store only after deferred loading from an initialized store action. Preserve in-flight generations, drafts and v4 preferences; this is not an eager initialization defect.
